column4: Added ToggleNavMesh (TNM) to show the navmesh
Off-screen NPCs no longer cut across areas with no navmesh
No longer turn towards navmesh corners when walking between navmesh tiles (e.g. Sunny leaving the saloon)
Debanding enabled: smoother gradients in skies and dark interiors
Updated the issue reporter (F10)
COC(Center on cell) now uses a door marker or navmesh if no coc marker exists in the cell
Now decide on their own if they can be activated (eg door openable). Ignored by ref.Activate
Added ref.SetDestroyed and ref.GetDestroyed
Added a "destroyed" flag to references
Added IsWeaponOut and GetWeaponAnimType
Projectiles can now signal the hit reference and trigger onhit scripts
NPC dialog handling improved when triggered by scripts
Freeside bus door now has collisions (fix bhkConvexTransformShape)
Fixed missing meshes when used more than once
No longer stop animating when crossing a cell boundary
Creatures now face the correct direction while animating
Muzzle flashes point down the barrel
Refraction and fading effects
Glowing materials and specular highlights
Animation cache is compressed and old versions are cleaned up
Added PlayGroup and IsAnimPlaying
Objects play their own animations
Animated textures now scroll
Transparent objects blend correctly
Lit objects use a new shader closer to the original
Unlit and effect meshes use the original shading
Equip items from the inventory debug tab
Mines and grenades leave the hand at the right moment
Weapons fire bullets and projectiles
Automatic weapon fire loops seamlessly
Automatic and semi-automatic and spin-up weapons fire correctly
Weapon sounds for firing and equipping and reloading
Weapon animations play on actors and first person arms
Weapons hang on actors when holstered and can be drawn and holstered
Added the in-game console
First person arms follow the player's animations
New animation system: idles play over walking and animations move the actor
Pick up and drop items; dropped items fall and settle
Moving objects simulate with physics
Choose the startup script
Choose where saves are stored
Lines being spoken resume after loading
Quick load on F6
Save and load games; quick save on F5
Creatures are placed in the world and can talk
Creatures animate when moving
Creatures have their full bodies
Added a Simulation debug tab and the issue reporter (F10)
Disabled NPCs stay hidden until enabled
Leveled NPCs match their area's level and use their race's face shapes
Templated NPCs are picked from their leveled list
New Game runs the game's own start script and then an optional custom startup script
Clouds turned off for now and frame rate uncapped
NPCs with the same skeleton share animation data
Quest scripts and idle off-screen NPCs update less often
NPCs use their own skin tone and face animations
Lip sync to voice lines
NPCs blink and show the emotion of their line
NPC heads have facial expressions
Actors stay put during conversations and the player turns to face them
Actors now turn to face who they are talking to if turning the head isn't enough
Added a Force finish button to the loading screen
Added a launcher to pick your game data folder and start a new game
Released as open source under GPL-3.0
